endpoint: Constructs without an added flank that were flagged
definition: construct sets B and C, no flank added
boundary: distinct endpoints from different controlled construct sets: the first pools unflanked controls from construct sets B and C, while the latter two share the same primary flanked constructs in set C; percentages must not be combined into an overall failure rate

endpoint: Primary flanked constructs without a provirus flag
definition: predicted trimming leaves an unflagged construct whole, so host removal is exactly 0
boundary: distinct endpoints from different controlled construct sets: the first pools unflanked controls from construct sets B and C, while the latter two share the same primary flanked constructs in set C; percentages must not be combined into an overall failure rate

endpoint: Primary flanked constructs retaining < 95% of viral bases
definition: viral bases retained after predicted trimming
boundary: distinct endpoints from different controlled construct sets: the first pools unflanked controls from construct sets B and C, while the latter two share the same primary flanked constructs in set C; percentages must not be combined into an overall failure rate
